responsibility: This grammar/action source defines parser pass 1 of mc. It specifies the first compilation-unit grammar together with semantic actions that discover module kind and names, establish top-level scopes, record root declarations and imports, classify comments for procedures, and insert enough structural AST and symbol information for later passes, while also providing syntax-recovery productions used by the generated mcp1 parser.
same_name_distinction: This .bnf file is the grammar-and-actions source for parser pass 1 under the mcp1 stem, containing productions plus semantic actions such as module lookup, scope entry, import registration, and comment attachment; mcp1.def only exposes the generated parser's CompilationUnit entry point.
